card.name: Words just before "week" in dosing
card.fires_on: Small words or numbers right before a time-span word, most often "week", as in "each", "third", "same", "every" or a number. Seen in dosing schedules and in the phrase "in 24 hours".

modes.label: Before "week"
modes.description: Words like each, third, same or Each that lead straight into "week".
modes.example: devout Jews throughout the Roman Empire who had formerly faithfully worshiped God on the seventh day of<< each>> week, converted to Christianity

modes.label: Number before days or weeks
modes.description: An empty slot or number before an interval such as 4 days, 7 days or 1-week.

modes.label: "in" before a time span
modes.description: The word "in" after a dose limit, ahead of "24 hours".
modes.example: not to exceed 30 mL<< in>> 24 hours. Children 6

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward "week" or "weekly" and away from "calendar" or "months".
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "week" or "weekly" in a dosing schedule.
